title: Rejecting conflicting generated-key and declared insert columns before execution
summary: Overlapping generated and supplied columns now fail during compilation. Correcting that same insert after failure returned a key identifying the only Sven row.

change.description: SimpleJdbcInsert compilation rejects an explicit insert column that is also named as generated. Matching ignores case and the diagnostic retains the declared spelling.

notes: The observer checks the failure type, declared column spelling, compiled state, table count and the row reached through the returned key.
